title: Best Danby Dehumidifier (2026): Models, Controls & Recalls
dek: Honest DOE ratings, a two-year warranty and a recall history worth knowing before you buy used.
description: The best Danby dehumidifier for every room — 22- to 60-pint models compared, the control panel icons explained, manual help and Danby’s two older recalls.
intro: A **Danby dehumidifier** is easy to find — Amazon, Walmart, Best Buy and Danby’s own store all stock them — and the Canadian brand, better known for compact fridges and portable air conditioners, has a few genuine advantages. Its current models carry honest ratings under the 2019 DOE test, and most come with a **two-year parts-and-labor warranty**, double the one-year coverage common at this price.

There’s also history most listings skip. Older Danby-branded dehumidifiers built by two outside manufacturers were part of two separate fire-hazard recalls, both covering units sold between 2009 and 2017. Current production isn’t affected, but a used or estate-sale unit needs a model-number check before it goes anywhere near an outlet.
Below are the Danby models worth buying today, plus a plain-English guide to the control panel and where to find your manual.
topPicksLead: For most basements, the **Danby 60-Pint with Pump & Wi-Fi (DDR060BMP2WDB)** is the one to buy: it covers up to 4,000 square feet, drains itself and sends full-tank alerts to your phone.

products.name: Danby 60-Pint Dehumidifier with Pump & Wi-Fi (DDR060BMP2WDB)
pros: Rated for up to 4,000 sq ft
Smart Dehumidify mode adjusts to room temperature
cons: App features you may not need for a small space
products.whyWeLoveIt: It’s the only current Danby that pairs a pump with app control, which makes it the closest thing to a hands-off basement dehumidifier in the lineup.
products.performance: Danby rates it for full basements of up to 4,000 square feet. Its Smart Dehumidify mode adjusts output to the ambient temperature rather than running the compressor flat out, and the pump can push water up to a sink or window. Compare large-capacity rivals in our [best dehumidifier for basement](/best/best-dehumidifier-for-basement/) guide.

products.name: Danby 22-Pint Dehumidifier (DDR020BJWDB-ME)
products.whyWeLoveIt: For a bedroom, home office or small apartment, it’s the right size and the simplest Danby to live with — no app, no pump, just a dependable panel and a hose option.
products.performance: Danby rates it for up to 1,500 square feet, though a single bedroom or office is a more realistic match for 22 DOE pints. You can empty the bucket or run a hose for continuous drainage. More small-room picks in our [best small dehumidifier](/best/best-small-dehumidifier/) guide.

products.name: Danby 30-Pint Dehumidifier (DDR030BJWDB-ME)
cons: Pint number looks smaller than older-scale rivals
products.whyWeLoveIt: It steps up from the 22-pint for a large bedroom suite, home gym or laundry room, without paying for a pump you don’t need.
products.performance: Danby rates it for up to 2,000 square feet. Because it’s rated under the 2019 DOE test, its 30 pints would have been marketed as a bigger number under the old standard — the unit isn’t weaker, the label is just more honest. Our [dehumidifier size guide](/guides/dehumidifier-size-guide/) explains the old-versus-new gap.

sections.heading: How we pick the best Danby dehumidifiers

blocks.text: We don’t lab-test. We compared Danby’s DOE capacity ratings, coverage claims, ENERGY STAR listings, warranty terms and manuals, and searched CPSC recall notices for every Danby model family. We then read owner reviews for recurring problems with pumps, Wi-Fi pairing and sensors.
We matched each pick to the space it realistically fits and favored features that reduce babysitting — pumps, drain ports and full-tank alerts.

sections.heading: What to look for in a Danby dehumidifier

items.label: Coverage over pint count
items.text: Danby’s “DoE” labels use the 2019 test, so its pint numbers look smaller than old-scale rivals for the same real output.

items.label: A clean model number
items.text: On any used unit, check the full model number against CPSC.gov before plugging it in.

items.label: Pump or no pump
items.text: Choose a pump model only if your drain is higher than the unit or there’s no drain nearby.

items.label: Wi-Fi only if you’ll use it
items.text: The 60-pint is the one connected model; the rest are panel-only.

items.label: The warranty
items.text: Register your unit — two years of parts and labor is a real edge at this price.

sections.heading: Danby dehumidifier controls, icons and settings explained

blocks.text: Danby’s control panels vary by model and year, but most share the same core buttons and indicator lights. Here’s what they typically mean — confirm the exact labels in your model’s manual.

head: Button or icon
What it usually does
rows: Turns the unit on and off; most current models remember settings after an outage
Sets the target relative humidity; the display may switch between the target and the room reading
Toggles between low and high airflow
Sets an automatic on or off delay in hours
Switches between holding a set humidity and running nonstop
The tank is full or not seated; the compressor stops until it’s emptied and reinstalled
A reminder to clean the washable filter; press and hold the filter button to reset it
The coil is icing in a cool room, so the unit pauses to melt it

blocks.text: The best Danby settings for most rooms

items: **Basements:** a target of 45–50% humidity on high fan for the first few days, then low fan once the room stabilizes.
**Bedrooms:** 45–50% on low fan for quieter running.
**Avoid Continuous** in finished living spaces — it can over-dry the room. Our [humidistat settings guide](/guides/dehumidifier-humidistat-settings-guide/) has seasonal targets.

sections.heading: Where to find a Danby dehumidifier manual

blocks.text: Danby’s support site lets you look up owner’s manuals and instruction guides by model number. You’ll find the model number on the rating label, usually on the back or side of the unit, often behind the bucket. Having it handy also lets you check the recall database in the same sitting.
If your Danby powers on but stops pulling water, work through our [dehumidifier not collecting water](/guides/dehumidifier-not-collecting-water/) checklist before calling for service.

sections.heading: The Danby recall history to know before buying used

items: **Gree-built units (2013, reannounced several times through 2023):** Danby models DDR3011, DDR30P, DDR4511, DDR45P, DDR6511 and DDR6511CHP were among about 2.5 million units across 13 brands, linked to more than 450 fires and $19 million in damage.

**New Widetech-built units (2021):** dehumidifiers sold from 2009 to 2017 under the Danby, Danby Designer, Danby Premiere, ArcticAire, Classic and Generations names, recalled for fire and burn hazards.

blocks.title: About older Danby Premiere models
blocks.text: Danby Premiere was one of the names covered in the 2021 recall. If you own or are offered an older Premiere unit, look up its exact model number on CPSC.gov before using it. Current new-production Danby models aren’t part of either recall.

The **Danby 60-Pint with Pump & Wi-Fi** is the best Danby for most basements, with app alerts no other current Danby offers. Pick the **22-Pint** for a bedroom or apartment, the **30-Pint** for a larger room and the **50-Pint with Pump** if you want self-draining without Wi-Fi. Buy new or through Danby’s refurbished channel, and check the model number on any used unit. To see how Danby compares with other names, read our [best dehumidifier brands](/best/best-dehumidifier-brands/) ranking.

faqs.q: What is the best Danby dehumidifier?
faqs.a: The Danby 60-Pint with Pump & Wi-Fi (DDR060BMP2WDB) for most basements. For a bedroom or apartment, the 22-Pint (DDR020BJWDB-ME). For a pump without Wi-Fi, the 50-Pint with Pump (DDR050BJP2WDB).

faqs.q: What do the icons on a Danby dehumidifier mean?
faqs.a: Most Danby panels show a bucket-full light (empty and reseat the tank), a filter light (clean the filter, then hold the button to reset), a defrost indicator (the coil is clearing ice) and timer or continuous-mode lights. Exact icons vary by model, so check your manual.

faqs.q: Where can I find my Danby dehumidifier manual?
faqs.a: On Danby’s support website, searchable by model number. The model number is on the rating label on the back or side of the unit, often behind the bucket.

faqs.q: What setting should my Danby dehumidifier be on?
faqs.a: For most homes, set the target humidity to 45–50%. Use high fan to dry a damp basement quickly, then low fan for steady, quieter running.

Yes, older ones. Gree-built Danby models (DDR3011, DDR30P, DDR4511, DDR45P, DDR6511, DDR6511CHP) were recalled starting in 2013, and New Widetech-built units under Danby, Danby Premiere and other names were recalled in 2021. Both cover units sold 2009–2017.

faqs.q: Is a Danby Premiere dehumidifier safe to use?
faqs.a: Check the exact model number first. Danby Premiere units sold between 2009 and 2017 were included in the 2021 recall. If yours is affected, stop using it and follow the CPSC remedy instructions.

faqs.q: How long is Danby’s dehumidifier warranty?
faqs.a: Most current models carry 24 months of parts-and-labor coverage, double the 12 months common among budget brands.
